outcome: Agreement between LiDCOrapid and NICOM devices in measuring cardiac output
cohort: 10 pregnant women at high risk of hemodynamic instability undergoing Cesarean section
finding: There was a large mean difference and unacceptably low level of agreement between cardiac output measurements obtained using the LiDCOrapid and NICOM devices in pregnant women at high risk of hemodynamic instability during Cesarean section.
